summary.text: Chris Croft is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 8 who has served since 2019, has been House majority leader since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a retired U.S. Army colonel who served from 1988 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Chris Croft served in the U.S. Army from 1988 to 2018 and reached the rank of colonel.

He earned a bachelor of science from the University of Central Florida in 1987 and a master's degree in Advanced Military and Operational Studies from the U.S. Army Command and General Staff College in 2001.

His career experience includes serving as an executive director with the Talent Management Task Force and the Center for Army Leadership, and he has been a member of the Army Week Association and American Fallen Warrior Memorial Foundation boards.
Croft assumed office in the Kansas House in 2019 and began serving as House majority leader in 2023.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Interstate Cooperation, Legislative Budget, Calendar and Printing (chair) and Legislative Coordinating Council committees.
Megan Phillips is the Democratic candidate for the seat in the November 2026 general election.
